title.narrative: Burundi Ugushora Program

description.narrative: Ugushora (to sell, to export) aims to build and enable local private sector initiatives that create impact with decent jobs and export earnings. This is done through focusing on: - Building export-oriented value chains- Attracting international interest- Tackling trade barriers- Harmonization of private sector and enabling environment initiatives

participating-org.narrative: Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands (EKN)

sector.narrative: The program focuses on private sector development through business development with international and local private sector stakeholders
